summary: Grey horizontal bars with upward projections move upward into semi-open grey slots, aligning projections with slot openings, then colored pixels within slots move upward to align vertically with the bar's projections
src: grey horizontal bar with upward vertical projections s
dst: semi-open grey slot region with downward colored vertical projections d
match_cond: s.projections align vertically with d.colored_projections (column positions match)
multi_step: Step 1: Identify grey bar s with upward projections and grey slot d with colored downward projections; Step 2: Move s upward into d such that s.projections fit into d.openings with projection-to-projection vertical alignment; Step 3: Move colored pixels upward so they align with bar projections, with bar bottom 1 cell above slot bottom
notes: The key geometric constraint: projections of the bar must align column-wise with the colored projections in the slot; movement distance varies based on projection lengths to achieve final alignment with 1-cell gap at bottom
src2: colored pixels c within the slot region
path2: move(c, direction='up') such that c.projections align vertically with s.projections and s.bottom_edge is 1 cell above slot.bottom_edge
